note: Provider settings for Tools/ai_images/generate_image.py. API keys are NEVER stored here or anywhere in the repo: they are read from the environment variables named in envKeys. Model ids change often; the ids below are starting points and have NOT been verified against a live account. Run `python Tools/ai_images/generate_image.py --provider gemini --list-models` (needs a key) to see what your account offers, then set the model here or with --model.
houseStyle: anime fantasy illustration, bright flowing cel-shaded look, clean line art, soft saturated colours, single subject, plain background, no text, no watermark, no logo

gemini.modelStatus: unverified; other ids seen in Google docs: gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-2.0-flash-preview-image-generation
gemini.termsNote: Google Gemini API terms apply. Check output ownership and any restrictions before an image goes anywhere near Game/.

otherProviders: Optional, not wired in: the image tools in Claude Desktop (Higgsfield, Canva, Figma, Miro). They can cost paid credits, so use them only on purpose.
Optional, not wired in: a local ComfyUI or Stable Diffusion install. The GTX 1650 has 4 GB of VRAM, so SDXL-class models need cloud or CPU.
